tools.name: develop
tools.description: Develop an idea, plan or task with an AI agent: elaborate it, fold in the answers to its open questions, and list what is still open (`develop`)

item.description: An idea, plan or task: an id such as I19, P19 or T19-2, a .md name or a path

guidance.description: What to do, e.g. "add user specific goals"

ai.description: The AI agent and model, [claude|copilot][:<model>], e.g. claude:fable; the first installed agent by default, BOARD_AI_COMMAND replaces it. An empty string gives the option without a value

project.description: The project the call works in: the path of its board.json, or of the folder that has it, absolute or relative to /pkg

tools.name: plan
tools.description: Write the plan of an idea, Plans/P<n> <subject>.md, with an AI agent (`plan`)

idea.description: An idea: an id such as I19, a .md name or a path

guidance.description: What the plan should aim at

ai.description: The AI agent and model, [claude|copilot][:<model>], e.g. claude:fable; the first installed agent by default, BOARD_AI_COMMAND replaces it. An empty string gives the option without a value

project.description: The project the call works in: the path of its board.json, or of the folder that has it, absolute or relative to /pkg

tools.name: tasks
tools.description: Break a plan into tasks, Tasks/T<n>-<m> <subject>.md, with an AI agent (`tasks`)

plan.description: A plan: an id such as P19, a .md name or a path

ai.description: The AI agent and model, [claude|copilot][:<model>], e.g. claude:fable; the first installed agent by default, BOARD_AI_COMMAND replaces it. An empty string gives the option without a value

project.description: The project the call works in: the path of its board.json, or of the folder that has it, absolute or relative to /pkg

tools.name: exec
tools.description: Carry out the tasks of a plan one by one with an AI agent, writing each result to Results/R<n>-<m> <subject>.md (`exec`)

plan.description: A plan: an id such as P19, a .md name or a path

ai.description: The AI agent and model, [claude|copilot][:<model>], e.g. claude:fable; the first installed agent by default, BOARD_AI_COMMAND replaces it. An empty string gives the option without a value

project.description: The project the call works in: the path of its board.json, or of the folder that has it, absolute or relative to /pkg

tools.name: archive
tools.description: Move an idea and its plan, tasks and results to Archive/I<n> <subject>/ (`archive`)

idea.description: An idea, or any item of it: an id such as I19, a .md name or a path

project.description: The project the call works in: the path of its board.json, or of the folder that has it, absolute or relative to /pkg

tools.name: list
tools.description: List the ideas, plans, tasks and results of the board (`list`)

project.description: The project the call works in: the path of its board.json, or of the folder that has it, absolute or relative to /pkg
